name: Magewright's Spectacles

effects.name: Intelligence
effects.tooltip: Intelligence +6 : This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.

effects.name: Spell Penetration
effects.tooltip: Spell Penetration III : Passive: +3 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.

effects.name: Concentration
effects.tooltip: Concentration +10 : Passive: +10 Competence bonus to the Concentration skill.

effects.name: Enhanced Concentration
effects.tooltip: Enhanced Concentration +5 : Passive: +5 Enhancement bonus to the Concentration skill.

effects.name: Nearly Finished - Magewright's Expertise
effects.tooltip: Magewright's Expertise : Spell Focus I: +1 to DCs for all spells. Magewright's Quick Wits : Chance to gain a 10 second buff of +12 Alchemical bonus to Universal Spell Power each time the wearer is hit by a physical attack.

flavor_text: A pair of spectacles often worn by House Cannith magewrights. It enhances the functions of one's brain, improving the ability of the wearer to focus his or her energies.

source.raw: House Cannith Manufactury , Stellite 's Chest (Rare encounter)
